translations.literal: During Jiatai, served as Wujiang assistant magistrate.
translations.idiomatic: During the Jiatai era he served as assistant magistrate of Wujiang.

sentences.zh: 蘇師旦恃韓侂胄威福，撓役法，提舉常平黃榮檄韶核田以定役。

translations.literal: Su Shidan relied on Han Tuozhou's power and arrogance, obstructed corvée law; Ever-Normal Granaries intendant Huang Rong dispatched Shao to survey fields to fix corvée.
translations.idiomatic: Su Shidan, relying on Han Tuozhou's power and arrogance, obstructed the corvée law; Huang Rong, intendant of Ever-Normal Granaries, ordered Shao by dispatch to survey fields and fix corvée assessments.

sentences.zh: 師旦密諭意言：“吳江多姻黨，儻相容，當薦為京朝官。

translations.literal: Shidan secretly conveyed intent, saying: "Wujiang has many kin-based factions; if you can accommodate, will recommend for capital office."
translations.idiomatic: Shidan secretly conveyed his intent, saying: "Wujiang has many kin-based factions; if you can accommodate them, I will recommend you for a capital office."

sentences.zh: ”韶不聽。

translations.literal: " Shao did not listen.
translations.idiomatic: Shao did not listen.

sentences.zh: 是歲更定戶籍，承徭賦，皆師旦黨，師旦諷言者將論去。

translations.literal: That year household registers were revised, bearing corvée and taxes—all Shidan's faction; Shidan hinted critics would be removed.
translations.idiomatic: That year the household registers were revised, bearing corvée and taxes—all were Shidan's faction. Shidan hinted to critics that they would be removed.

sentences.zh: 榮亟以是事白於朝，且薦之。

translations.literal: Rong quickly reported this matter to the court, and also recommended him.
translations.idiomatic: Huang Rong quickly reported this matter to the court and also recommended him.

sentences.zh: 未幾，師旦敗。

translations.literal: Before long, Shidan fell.
translations.idiomatic: Before long, Shidan fell from power.

sentences.zh: 改知桐廬縣。

translations.literal: Transferred to serve as magistrate of Tonglu County.
translations.idiomatic: He was transferred to serve as magistrate of Tonglu County.

sentences.zh: 桐廬多宗室，持縣事無有善去者。

translations.literal: Tonglu had many imperial clansmen; those holding county affairs none left well.
translations.idiomatic: Tonglu had many imperial clansmen, and those who held county affairs rarely left with a good outcome.

sentences.zh: 韶始至，絕私謁，莫敢撓。

translations.literal: When Shao first arrived, cut off private audiences; none dared interfere.
translations.idiomatic: When Shao first arrived, he cut off private audiences, and no one dared interfere.

sentences.zh: 錢塘岸歲為潮齧，率取石桐廬，韶言：“廟子山有石，不必旁取鄰郡。

translations.literal: Qiantang riverbank yearly gnawed by tides, routinely took stone from Tonglu; Shao said: "Miaozi Mountain has stone, need not seize from neighboring prefectures."
translations.idiomatic: Each year the Qiantang riverbank was gnawed by tides, and stone was routinely taken from Tonglu. Shao said: "Miaozi Mountain has stone; there is no need to seize it from neighboring prefectures."

sentences.zh: ”遂得求免。

translations.literal: " Thus obtained exemption from the levy.
translations.idiomatic: Thus the levy was exempted.

sentences.zh: 嘉定四年，召為太常寺主簿，父老旗鼓蔽江以餞，至於富陽，泣謝曰：“吾曹不復輸石矣。”

translations.literal: Fourth year of Jiading, summoned as chief clerk of Court of Imperial Sacrifices; elders with drums and banners covered the river to see him off; reaching Fuyang, weeping thanked him: "We shall never again supply stone."
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth year of Jiading he was summoned as chief clerk of the Court of Imperial Sacrifices. Elders with drums and banners lined the river to see him off; reaching Fuyang, they wept and thanked him: "We shall never again supply stone!"

sentences.zh: 後為右司郎官、接伴金使。

translations.literal: Later served as Right Department Director, escort for Jin envoys.
translations.idiomatic: Later he served as Right Department Director and escorted Jin envoys.

sentences.zh: 使者索歲幣，語慢甚，韶曰：“昔兩國誓約，止令輸燕，不聞在汴。

translations.literal: Envoy demanded annual tribute, speech very insolent; Shao said: "Formerly two states swore oath, only fixed payment to Yan, not heard at Bian."
translations.idiomatic: The envoy demanded annual tribute, speaking with great insolence. Shao said: "Formerly the two states swore an oath fixing payment only to Yan—not at Bian."

sentences.zh: ”使者語塞。

translations.literal: " The envoy was speechless.
translations.idiomatic: The envoy was left speechless.

sentences.zh: 十三年，為臨安府尹，幾十年，理訟精簡，道不拾遺，裏巷爭呼為“佛子”，平反冤獄甚多。

translations.literal: Thirteenth year, served as Lin'an prefect; nearly ten years, adjudicated cases with precision and brevity, roads untroubled by theft, alleys clamored to call him "Buddha-son," overturned many wrongful convictions.
translations.idiomatic: In the thirteenth year he became prefect of Lin'an; for nearly ten years he adjudicated cases with precision and brevity, the roads went untroubled by theft, alleys clamored to call him "Buddha-son," and he overturned many wrongful convictions.

sentences.zh: 紹定元年，拜參知政事。

translations.literal: First year of Shaoding, appointed Vice Grand Councillor.
translations.idiomatic: In the first year of Shaoding he was appointed Vice Grand Councillor.

sentences.zh: 胡夢昱論濟王事，當遠竄，韶獨以夢昱無罪，不肯署文書。

translations.literal: Hu Mengyu judged for Prince of Ji affair, should be exiled far; Shao alone held Mengyu innocent, refused to sign documents.
translations.idiomatic: When Hu Mengyu was judged for the Prince of Ji affair and should be exiled far, Shao alone held Mengyu innocent and refused to sign the documents.

sentences.zh: 李全叛，揚州告急，飛檄載道，都城爭有逃避者。

translations.literal: Li Quan rebelled, Yangzhou reported emergency, urgent dispatches filled the roads, capital scrambled to flee.
translations.idiomatic: Li Quan rebelled; Yangzhou reported an emergency; urgent dispatches filled the roads; and people in the capital scrambled to flee.

sentences.zh: 乃拜韶浙西製置使，仍治臨安鎮遏之。

translations.literal: Then appointed Shao military commissioner of Western Zhejiang, still governing Lin'an to suppress panic.
translations.idiomatic: Shao was appointed military commissioner of Western Zhejiang, still governing Lin'an to suppress the panic.

sentences.zh: 丞相史彌遠懲韓侂胄用兵事，不欲聲討。

translations.literal: Grand Councillor Shi Miyuan chastened by Han Tuozhou's war, did not wish to openly campaign.
translations.idiomatic: Grand Councillor Shi Miyuan, chastened by Han Tuozhou's war, did not wish to openly campaign against Quan.

sentences.zh: 韶與範楷言於彌遠曰：“揚失守則京口不可保，淮將如卞整、崔福皆可用。

translations.literal: Shao and Fan Kai said to Miyuan: "If Yang falls then Jingkou cannot be held; Huai generals like Bian Zheng, Cui Fu all usable."
translations.idiomatic: Shao and Fan Kai said to Miyuan: "If Yang falls, Jingkou cannot be held. Huai generals like Bian Zheng and Cui Fu are all usable."

sentences.zh: ”適福至，韶夜與同見彌遠，言福實可用。

translations.literal: " Just then Fu arrived; Shao at night went with him to see Miyuan, said Fu truly usable.
translations.idiomatic: Just then Fu arrived; Shao went with him at night to see Miyuan and said Fu was truly usable.

sentences.zh: 彌遠從之，遂討全。

translations.literal: Miyuan assented, then campaigned against Quan.
translations.idiomatic: Miyuan assented, and they proceeded to campaign against Quan.

sentences.zh: 韶卒以言罷。

translations.literal: Shao ultimately dismissed because of his words.
translations.idiomatic: Shao was ultimately dismissed because of his words.

sentences.zh: 端平初，奉祠，卒年七十有七，贈少傅。

translations.literal: Start of Duanping, held temple sinecure; died age seventy-seven; posthumously honored Junior Grand Mentor.
translations.idiomatic: At the start of Duanping he held a temple sinecure; he died at seventy-seven and was posthumously honored as Junior Grand Mentor.

sentences.zh: 後以郊恩，累贈太師、越國公。

translations.literal: Later through suburban grace, cumulatively honored Grand Preceptor, Duke of Yue.
translations.idiomatic: Later, through suburban grace, he was cumulatively honored as Grand Preceptor and Duke of Yue.

sentences.zh: 韶之父為郡小吏，給事通判廳，勤謹無失，歲滿當代，不聽去。

translations.literal: Shao's father was minor prefectural clerk, serving vice prefect's office, diligent and careful without fault; term expired should be replaced, not allowed to leave.
translations.idiomatic: Shao's father was a minor prefectural clerk serving in the vice prefect's office, diligent and careful without fault. When his term expired he should have been replaced, but they would not let him leave.

sentences.zh: 後通判至，復留用之，因致豐饒。

translations.literal: Later vice prefect arrived, again kept and employed, thus became prosperous.
translations.idiomatic: When a later vice prefect arrived, he was again kept on and employed, and thus became prosperous.

sentences.zh: 夫妻俱近五十，無子，其妻資遣之往臨安置妾。

translations.literal: Husband and wife both nearly fifty, childless; his wife provided funds and sent him to Lin'an to take concubine.
translations.idiomatic: Husband and wife were both nearly fifty and childless; his wife provided funds and sent him to Lin'an to take a concubine.

sentences.zh: 既得妾，察之有憂色，且以麻束發，外以彩飾之。

translations.literal: Having obtained concubine, observed she had worried expression, and hair bound with hemp, outwardly decorated with colors.
translations.idiomatic: Having obtained a concubine, he observed she had a worried expression, and her hair was bound with hemp but decorated outwardly with colors.

sentences.zh: 問之，泣曰：“妾故趙知府女也，家四川，父歿家貧，故鬻妾以為歸葬計耳。

translations.literal: Questioning her, she wept and said: "I am former Prefect Zhao's daughter, family in Sichuan; father died, family poor, thus sold me to plan return and burial."
translations.idiomatic: Questioning her, she wept and said: "I am the daughter of the former Prefect Zhao; my family is in Sichuan. My father died and the family was poor, so I was sold to raise funds for his return and burial."

sentences.zh: ”即送還之。

translations.literal: " Immediately sent her back.
translations.idiomatic: He immediately sent her back.

sentences.zh: 其母泣曰：“計女聘財猶未足以給歸費，且用破矣，將何以酬汝？

translations.literal: Her mother wept and said: "Calculated bride-price still insufficient for return expenses, and already spent—how repay you?"
translations.idiomatic: Her mother wept and said: "The calculated bride-price still falls short for return expenses, and it is already spent—how shall we repay you?"

sentences.zh: ”徐曰：“賤吏不敢辱娘子，聘財盡以相奉。

translations.literal: " He said slowly: "This humble clerk dare not dishonor the young lady; bride-price entirely give to you."
translations.idiomatic: He said slowly: "This humble clerk dare not dishonor the young lady; the bride-price I give entirely to you."

sentences.zh: ”且聞其家尚不給，盡以囊中貲與之，遂獨歸。

translations.literal: " And hearing their household still lacked, gave everything in his purse, then returned alone.
translations.idiomatic: Learning their household still lacked funds, he gave everything in his purse and returned alone.

sentences.zh: 妻迎問之曰：“妾安在？

translations.literal: His wife came out to greet and asked: "Where is the concubine?"
translations.idiomatic: His wife came out to greet him and asked: "Where is the concubine?"

sentences.zh: ”告以其故，且曰：“吾思之，無子命也。

translations.literal: " He told the reason, and said: "I have thought—being childless is fate."
translations.idiomatic: He told her the reason and said: "I have thought about it—being childless is fate."

sentences.zh: 我與汝周旋久，若有子，汝豈不育，必待他婦人乃育哉？

translations.literal: You and I have been together long; if there were a child, would you not raise it—must wait for another woman to bear one?
translations.idiomatic: You and I have been together long; if we were to have a child, would you not raise it? Must we wait for another woman to bear one?

sentences.zh: ”妻亦喜曰：“君設心如此，行當有子矣。

translations.literal: " His wife also delighted: "With such intent as yours, soon there will be a child."
translations.idiomatic: His wife also delighted and said: "With such intent as yours, we shall surely have a child soon."

sentences.zh: ”明年生韶。

translations.literal: " The next year Shao was born.
translations.idiomatic: The next year Shao was born.

sentences.zh: 危稹，字逢吉，撫州臨川人。

translations.literal: Wei Zhen, styled Fengji, native of Linchuan in Fuzhou.
translations.idiomatic: Wei Zhen, styled Fengji, was a native of Linchuan in Fuzhou.

sentences.zh: 舊名科，淳熙十四年舉進士，孝宗更名稹。

translations.literal: Formerly named Ke; fourteenth year of Chunxi passed jinshi examination; Emperor Xiaozong renamed him Zhen.
translations.idiomatic: Formerly named Ke, he passed the jinshi examination in the fourteenth year of Chunxi; Emperor Xiaozong renamed him Zhen.

sentences.zh: 時洪邁得稹文，為之賞激。

translations.literal: At the time Hong Mai obtained Zhen's writing, deeply impressed by it.
translations.idiomatic: At the time Hong Mai saw Zhen's writing and was deeply impressed.

sentences.zh: 調南康軍教授。

translations.literal: Assigned instructor at Nankang Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: He was assigned as instructor at Nankang Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 轉運使楊萬里按部，驟見歎獎，偕遊廬山，相與酬倡。

translations.literal: Transport Commissioner Yang Wanli on inspection tour suddenly saw and praised him; together toured Mount Lu, exchanged verses.
translations.idiomatic: Transport Commissioner Yang Wanli, on an inspection tour, suddenly saw him and praised him; together they toured Mount Lu and exchanged verses.

sentences.zh: 調廣東帳司，未上，服父喪，免，調臨安府教授。

translations.literal: Assigned Guangdong accounts office, before taking post mourned father and was relieved; assigned instructor at Lin'an Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: Assigned to the Guangdong accounts office, he had not yet taken up the post when he mourned his father and was relieved; he was then assigned as instructor at Lin'an Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 倪思薦之，且語人曰：“吾得此一士，可以報國矣。

translations.literal: Ni Si recommended him, and told others: "Having gained this one scholar, can serve the state."
translations.idiomatic: Ni Si recommended him and told others: "Having gained this one scholar, I can serve the state."

sentences.zh: ”丁母憂，免，幹辦京西安撫司公事。

translations.literal: " After mourning mother, relieved; staff officer of Western Capital Pacification Commission.
translations.idiomatic: After mourning his mother he was relieved and became staff officer of the Western Capital Pacification Commission.

sentences.zh: 入為武學諭，改太學錄。

translations.literal: Entered service as Military Academy instructor, changed to Imperial Academy Recorder.
translations.idiomatic: He entered service as instructor at the Military Academy and was changed to Recorder of the Imperial Academy.

sentences.zh: 明年，遷武學博士，又遷諸王宮教授。

translations.literal: Next year, promoted Military Academy Doctor, then promoted instructor at Princes' Palace.
translations.idiomatic: The next year he was promoted to Doctor of the Military Academy, then to instructor at the Princes' Palace.

sentences.zh: 稹謂以教名官，而實未嚐教，請改創宗子學，立課試法如兩學，從之。

translations.literal: Zhen said though titled instructor, in fact had not truly taught; requested to establish School for Imperial Clansmen, set examination methods like the two academies—assented.
translations.idiomatic: Zhen observed that though titled instructor, he had not truly taught; he requested to establish a School for Imperial Clansmen with examination methods like the two academies—the court assented.

sentences.zh: 嘉定九年，新學成，改充博士，其教養之規，稹所論建。

translations.literal: Ninth year of Jiading, new school completed, changed to serve as doctor; its training regulations, Zhen proposed and established.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth year of Jiading the new school was completed; he was made its doctor, and its training regulations were proposed by Zhen.

sentences.zh: 遷秘書郎、著作佐郎，兼吳益王府教授。

translations.literal: Promoted Secretary, Assistant Compilation Officer, concurrently instructor at Prince Wu Yi's palace.
translations.idiomatic: He was promoted to Secretary and Assistant Compilation Officer, concurrently serving as instructor at Prince Wu Yi's palace.

sentences.zh: 升著作郎兼屯田郎官。

translations.literal: Elevated Compilation Officer concurrently Director of State Farms.
translations.idiomatic: He was elevated to Compilation Officer concurrently serving as Director of State Farms.

sentences.zh: 稹始進對，請敘復軍功之賞以立大信，抆拭功臣之罪以厲忠節，置局以立武事，遣使以省邊防，厚賞以精間諜。

translations.literal: On Zhen's first audience, requested restoring military merit rewards to establish great trust, wiping away meritorious ministers' crimes to encourage loyalty, establishing bureaus for military affairs, dispatching envoys to inspect border defenses, generous rewards to cultivate spies.
translations.idiomatic: On his first audience Zhen requested restoring military merit rewards to establish great trust, wiping away meritorious ministers' crimes to encourage loyalty, establishing bureaus for military affairs, dispatching envoys to inspect border defenses, and generous rewards to cultivate spies.

sentences.zh: 次論和、戰、守利害，而請專意於守。

translations.literal: Next discussed peace, war, defense pros and cons, and requested exclusive focus on defense.
translations.idiomatic: Next he discussed the pros and cons of peace, war, and defense, and requested exclusive focus on defense.

sentences.zh: 是歲春至夏不雨，稹應詔言：“安邊所征斂之害，與無罪而籍沒之害；

translations.literal: That year spring to summer no rain; Zhen responding to edict said: "Border pacification levies' harm, and innocent confiscation's harm;"
translations.idiomatic: That year from spring to summer there was no rain; responding to the edict Zhen said: "The harm of border pacification levies, and the harm of confiscating the innocent—"

sentences.zh: 楮幣之改，以一奪二；

translations.literal: paper currency change, taking one for two;
translations.idiomatic: changing paper currency, taking one for two;

sentences.zh: 鹽鈔之更，以新廢舊；

translations.literal: salt certificate change, discarding old for new;
translations.idiomatic: changing salt certificates, discarding old for new;

sentences.zh: 至於沮格軍賞，放散死士，皆足以召怨而致旱。”

translations.literal: as for blocking military rewards, disbanding veteran soldiers—all sufficient to summon resentment and bring drought."
translations.idiomatic: as for blocking military rewards and disbanding veteran soldiers—all are sufficient to summon resentment and bring drought."

sentences.zh: 明年又論：“謀國者欲以安靖為安靖，憂國者欲以振厲為安靖，自二議不合，是以國無成謀，人無定誌。

translations.literal: Next year again argued: "State planners take quiet ease for peace, patriots take invigorating effort for peace; since two views disagree, state lacks settled plans, people lack fixed resolve."
translations.idiomatic: The next year he argued again: "State planners take quiet ease for peace; patriots take invigorating effort for peace. Since the two views disagree, the state lacks settled plans and people lack fixed resolve."

sentences.zh: 願詔大臣合二議共圖之，且欲下兩淮帥臣，講明守禦之備。

translations.literal: Wish Emperor command grand ministers to unite both views and plan together, and also send orders to Two Huai commanders to clarify defensive preparations.
translations.idiomatic: I wish the Emperor would command grand ministers to unite both views and plan together, and also send orders to the Two Huai commanders to clarify defensive preparations.

sentences.zh: ”最後言：“事無成規者，皆不可為。

translations.literal: " Finally said: "What lacks established rules cannot be done."
translations.idiomatic: Finally he said: "What lacks established rules cannot be done."

sentences.zh: 意向不明，無以一眾聽；

translations.literal: If intent unclear, cannot unify multitude's hearing;
translations.idiomatic: If intent is unclear, one cannot unify the multitude's hearing;

sentences.zh: 信誓不立，無以結人心；

translations.literal: If sworn faith not established, cannot bind people's hearts;
translations.idiomatic: If sworn faith is not established, one cannot bind people's hearts;

sentences.zh: 報應不亟，無以趨事機；

translations.literal: If response not swift, cannot seize the moment;
translations.idiomatic: If response is not swift, one cannot seize the moment;

sentences.zh: 賞罰不果，無以作士氣。”

translations.literal: If rewards and punishments not decisive, cannot rouse soldiers' morale."
translations.idiomatic: If rewards and punishments are not decisive, one cannot rouse soldiers' morale."

sentences.zh: 番易柴中行去國，稹賦詩送之，迕宰相，出知潮州。

translations.literal: Poyi Chai Zhongxing left the capital; Zhen composed farewell poem, offended chancellor, sent out as prefect of Chaozhou.
translations.idiomatic: When Poyi Chai Zhongxing left the capital, Zhen composed a farewell poem that offended the chancellor; he was sent out as prefect of Chaozhou.

sentences.zh: 尋以通金華徐僑書論罷，提舉千秋鴻禧觀。

translations.literal: Soon dismissed for correspondence with Jinhua Xu Qiao on policy; made director of Qianqiu Hongxi Observatory.
translations.idiomatic: Soon he was dismissed for correspondence with Jinhua's Xu Qiao on policy and was made director of the Qianqiu Hongxi Observatory.

sentences.zh: 久之，知漳州。

translations.literal: After long time, appointed prefect of Zhangzhou.
translations.idiomatic: After a long time he was appointed prefect of Zhangzhou.

sentences.zh: 漳俗視不葬親為常，往往棲寄僧刹，稹命營高燥地為義塚三，約期責之葬，其無主名、若有主名而力弗給者，官為葬之，凡二千三百有奇，刻石以識。

translations.literal: Zhang custom treated leaving parents unburied as normal, often lodging coffins in monasteries; Zhen ordered three charity burial grounds on high dry land, set deadlines requiring burial; those without claimants or with claimants lacking means—government buried them, totaling over twenty-three hundred, stone markers inscribed.
translations.idiomatic: Zhang custom treated leaving parents unburied as normal, often lodging coffins in monasteries. Zhen ordered three charity burial grounds on high dry land and set deadlines requiring burial; those without claimants, or with claimants lacking means, the government buried—totaling over twenty-three hundred, with stone markers inscribed.

sentences.zh: 郡有臨漳台，據溪山最勝處，作龍江書院其上。

translations.literal: Prefecture had Linzhang Terrace at finest stream-and-mountain site; built Longjiang Academy upon it.
translations.idiomatic: The prefecture had Linzhang Terrace at the finest stream-and-mountain site; he built Longjiang Academy upon it.

sentences.zh: 既成，橫經自講，人用歆動。

translations.literal: When completed, lectured on classics himself; people deeply stirred.
translations.idiomatic: When it was completed, he lectured on the classics himself, and people were deeply stirred.

sentences.zh: 邑令有賄聞者，劾去之，籍其財以還民。

translations.literal: County magistrate reported for bribery; impeached and removed, registered his wealth to return to people.
translations.idiomatic: A county magistrate was reported for bribery; Zhen impeached and removed him, registering his wealth to return to the people.

sentences.zh: 郡有經、總製無名錢歲五千緡，厲民為甚，前守趙汝讜奏蠲五之二，稹疏於朝，悉罷之。

translations.literal: Prefecture had jing and zongzhi unnamed funds five thousand strings yearly, severely burdening people; former prefect Zhao Ruzan memorialized to remit two-fifths; Zhen memorialized to court, entirely abolished.
translations.idiomatic: The prefecture had unnamed funds from jing and zongzhi levies of five thousand strings yearly, severely burdening the people. Former prefect Zhao Ruzan had memorialized to remit two-fifths; Zhen memorialized to the court and abolished them entirely.

sentences.zh: 會常平使有言，稹不欲辯，即自請以歸。

translations.literal: When Ever-Normal intendant spoke against him, Zhen would not argue, immediately requested to return.
translations.idiomatic: When the Ever-Normal intendant spoke against him, Zhen would not argue and immediately requested to return home.

sentences.zh: 久之，提舉崇禧觀，與鄉里耆艾七人為真率會。

translations.literal: After long time, director of Chongxi Observatory; with seven village elders formed Plain Sincerity club.
translations.idiomatic: After a long time he became director of the Chongxi Observatory and, with seven village elders, formed a Plain Sincerity club.

sentences.zh: 卒，年七十四。

translations.literal: Died, age seventy-four.
translations.idiomatic: He died at seventy-four.

sentences.zh: 稹性至孝，父疾，願損己算益親年，疾尋愈。

translations.literal: Zhen's nature exceptionally filial; when father ill, wished to shorten own lifespan to extend parent's years; illness soon healed.
translations.idiomatic: Zhen was exceptionally filial; when his father fell ill, he wished to shorten his own lifespan to extend his parent's years, and the illness soon healed.

sentences.zh: 真德秀登從班，舉稹自代，沒，又為銘其墓。

translations.literal: When Zhen Dexiu entered secondary rank, recommended Zhen to succeed him; after Zhen's death, also wrote his tomb inscription.
translations.idiomatic: When Zhen Dexiu entered the secondary rank, he recommended Zhen to succeed him; after Zhen's death, Dexiu also wrote his tomb inscription.

sentences.zh: 所著有《巽齋集》，諸經有講義、集解，諸魏、晉、唐詩文皆有編，輯先賢奏議曰《玉府》、曰《藥山》。

translations.literal: Works authored include "Xunzhai Collection"; classics have commentaries and collected exegeses; Wei, Jin, Tang poetry and prose all compiled; edited ancestral memorials titled "Jade Archive," "Medicine Mountain."
translations.idiomatic: His works included the Xunzhai Collection; commentaries and collected exegeses on the classics; compilations of Wei, Jin, and Tang poetry and prose; and edited ancestral memorials titled Jade Archive and Medicine Mountain.

sentences.zh: 弟和，字祥仲。

translations.literal: Younger brother He, styled Xiangzhong.
translations.idiomatic: His younger brother He, styled Xiangzhong.

sentences.zh: 開禧元年進士，為上元主簿，大辟祠宇祀程顥，真德秀為記之。

translations.literal: In the first year of Kaixi he passed the jinshi examination, served as chief clerk of Shangyuan, greatly expanded temple halls to sacrifice to Cheng Hao; Zhen Dexiu wrote the inscription.
translations.idiomatic: He passed the jinshi examination in the first year of Kaixi, served as chief clerk of Shangyuan, greatly expanded temple halls to sacrifice to Cheng Hao, and Zhen Dexiu wrote the inscription.

sentences.zh: 知德興，振荒有惠政。

translations.literal: Appointed magistrate of Dexing; relief during famine showed benevolent administration.
translations.idiomatic: As magistrate of Dexing, he relieved famine with policies that earned the people's gratitude.

sentences.zh: 有《蟾塘文集》。

translations.literal: He authored the "Chantang Collection."
translations.idiomatic: He authored the Chantang Collection.

sentences.zh: 程公許，字季與，一字希穎，敘州宣化人。

translations.literal: Cheng Gongxu, styled Jiyu, also known as Xiying, was a native of Xuanhua in Xuzhou.
translations.idiomatic: Cheng Gongxu, styled Jiyu and also known as Xiying, was a native of Xuanhua in Xuzhou.

sentences.zh: 少知孝敬，大母侯疾，公許不交睫者數月，病革，嚐其痰沫，既卒，哀毀逾製。

translations.literal: From youth he knew filial piety and respect; when his great-grandmother fell ill, Gongxu did not close his eyes for months; when her illness turned critical he tasted her phlegm; after she died his grief exceeded prescribed mourning.
translations.idiomatic: From youth he was filial and respectful. When his great-grandmother fell ill, Gongxu went months without sleep; as her illness turned critical he tasted her phlegm, and after she died his grief exceeded the prescribed mourning.

sentences.zh: 嘉定四年舉進士，調溫江尉，未上，丁母憂。

translations.literal: In the fourth year of Jiading he passed the jinshi examination, was assigned as assistant magistrate of Wenjiang, had not taken up the post when his mother died.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth year of Jiading he passed the jinshi examination and was assigned as assistant magistrate of Wenjiang, but before he could take up the post his mother died.

sentences.zh: 服除，授華陽尉，再調綿州教授。

translations.literal: When mourning ended he was appointed assistant magistrate of Huayang, then transferred to serve as professor at Mian Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: When his mourning ended he was appointed assistant magistrate of Huayang, then transferred to serve as professor at Mian Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 製置使崔與之大加器賞，改秩知崇寧縣，蠲預借，免抑配，人甚德之。

translations.literal: Pacification commissioner Cui Yu greatly valued and appreciated him, promoted his rank to magistrate of Chongning County, remitted advance loans and exempted forced apportionment; the people greatly esteemed him.
translations.idiomatic: Pacification commissioner Cui Yu greatly valued him, promoted his rank, and appointed him magistrate of Chongning County, where he remitted advance loans and exempted forced apportionment; the people deeply esteemed him.

sentences.zh: 差通判簡州。

translations.literal: He was assigned as vice-prefect of Jian Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: He was assigned as vice-prefect of Jian Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 改隆州，未上。

translations.literal: He was transferred to Long Prefecture but did not take up the post.
translations.idiomatic: He was transferred to Long Prefecture but did not take up the post.

sentences.zh: 會金人犯閬中，製置使桂如淵遁，三川震動，朝廷擢李代之，辟公許通判施州，行戶房公事。

translations.literal: When the Jin invaded Langzhong, pacification commissioner Gui Ruyuan fled; the Three Sichuan circuits were shaken; the court elevated Li Rong to replace him and recruited Gongxu as vice-prefect of Shi Prefecture, acting in the fiscal office.
translations.idiomatic: When the Jin invaded Langzhong, pacification commissioner Gui Ruyuan fled and the Three Sichuan circuits were shaken. The court elevated Li Rong to replace him and recruited Gongxu as vice-prefect of Shi Prefecture, acting in the fiscal office.

sentences.zh: 當兵將奔潰之後，公許盡力佐之，節浮費，疏利原，民不增賦而用自足。

translations.literal: After the army and officers had broken and fled, Gongxu exerted all effort to assist; he cut wasteful expenses and opened sources of revenue so the people needed no increased levies yet supplies were sufficient.
translations.idiomatic: After the army and officers had broken and fled, Gongxu exerted every effort to assist Li Rong: he cut wasteful spending, opened new revenue sources, and kept the people from added levies while supplies remained sufficient.

sentences.zh: 時諸將乘亂抄劫，事定自危，以重賂結幕府。

translations.literal: At that time the generals took advantage of the chaos to plunder; when order was restored they feared for themselves and sought to bind the headquarters with heavy bribes.
translations.idiomatic: At that time the generals took advantage of the chaos to plunder; once order was restored they feared for themselves and tried to bind the headquarters with heavy bribes.

sentences.zh: 大將和彥威懷金寶以獻，公許正色卻之，彥威慚而退。

translations.literal: Grand general He Yanwei came bearing gold and jewels to offer; Gongxu sternly refused them; Yanwei withdrew in shame.
translations.idiomatic: Grand general He Yanwei came bearing gold and jewels as a gift; Gongxu sternly refused them, and Yanwei withdrew in shame.

sentences.zh: 吳彥者，緘僧牒於書尾以進，公許卷還之而責其使，聞者畏服。

translations.literal: A man named Wu Yan sealed a monk's certificate at the end of a letter to present it; Gongxu rolled the letter back and returned it while rebuking the messenger; those who heard were awed and submitted.
translations.idiomatic: A man named Wu Yan sealed a monk's certificate at the end of a letter and sent it in; Gongxu rolled the letter back, returned it, and rebuked the messenger; those who heard were awed into submission.

sentences.zh: 有獻議招秦、鞏大姓於者，眾多從臾，獨公許謂山東覆轍未遠，反覆論難，從之。

translations.literal: Someone proposed recruiting the great clans of Qin and Gong to Li Rong; many urged him on, but Gongxu alone said the overturned cart in Shandong was not long past; he argued repeatedly and Li Rong followed his counsel.
translations.idiomatic: Someone proposed recruiting the great clans of Qin and Gong to Li Rong's side; many urged him on, but Gongxu alone said the overturned cart in Shandong was not long past. He argued repeatedly, and Li Rong followed his counsel.

sentences.zh: 其後趙彥呐開閫，復行其策。

translations.literal: Later Zhao Yanna opened a command; the earlier policy was carried out again.
translations.idiomatic: Later Zhao Yanna opened a command, and the earlier policy was carried out again.

sentences.zh: 未幾，金人搗成都，大姓者實導之，始服公許先見。

translations.literal: Before long the Jin struck at Chengdu; the great clans had in fact guided them; people then acknowledged Gongxu's foresight.
translations.idiomatic: Before long the Jin struck at Chengdu, and the great clans had in fact guided them; only then did people acknowledge Gongxu's foresight.

sentences.zh: 端平初，授大理司直，遷太常博士。

translations.literal: At the beginning of Duanping he was appointed Direct Investigator of the Court of Judicial Review, then promoted to Erudite of the Court of Imperial Sacrifices.
translations.idiomatic: At the beginning of Duanping he was appointed Direct Investigator of the Court of Judicial Review, then promoted to Erudite of the Court of Imperial Sacrifices.

sentences.zh: 秋祀明堂，雷雨，應詔言事。

translations.literal: During the autumn sacrifice at the Bright Hall, thunder and rain fell; he responded to the imperial decree to speak on affairs of state.
translations.idiomatic: During the autumn sacrifice at the Bright Hall, thunder and rain fell, and he responded to the imperial decree to speak on affairs of state.

sentences.zh: 嘉熙元年，御史杜範論執政李鳴復，不行，徙右史，竟拂衣東歸，鳴復坐政府自若。

translations.literal: In the first year of Jiaxi, censor Du Fan criticized chief minister Li Mingfu; nothing was done; Du was moved to Right Scribe; in the end he shook out his robes and returned east; Mingfu sat in the government as if nothing had happened.
translations.idiomatic: In the first year of Jiaxi, censor Du Fan criticized chief minister Li Mingfu, but nothing was done. Du was moved to Right Scribe and in the end shook out his robes and returned east, while Mingfu sat in the government as if nothing had happened.

sentences.zh: 公許輪對，言：“誌士仁人，嬰逆鱗，賈眾怒，不過為陛下通耳目，為朝廷立綱紀而已。

translations.literal: Gongxu spoke in turn at audience, saying: "Men of purpose and benevolence who risk the dragon's scales and invite the wrath of the multitude do no more than open Your Majesty's ears and eyes and establish discipline for the court."
translations.idiomatic: Gongxu spoke in turn at audience: "Men of purpose and benevolence who risk the dragon's scales and invite the wrath of the multitude do no more than open Your Majesty's ears and eyes and establish discipline for the court."

sentences.zh: 今也假以職而棄其諫，幸其退而優其遷，則是自裂其綱紀，自蔽其耳目，遂使居是職者雖被親擢，言不得行，始焉固辭而弗從，終焉強留而飲愧。

translations.literal: Now to appoint them to office yet discard their remonstrance, to rejoice at their withdrawal yet favor their transfer—is to tear apart one's own discipline and blind one's own ears and eyes, so that those who hold such posts, though personally promoted, cannot have their words acted upon; at first they firmly decline and are not heeded; in the end they are forcibly retained and swallow shame.
translations.idiomatic: Now to appoint them to office yet discard their remonstrance, to rejoice at their withdrawal yet favor their transfer, is to tear apart one's own discipline and blind one's own ears and eyes. Those who hold such posts, though personally promoted, cannot have their words acted upon: at first they firmly decline and are not heeded; in the end they are forcibly retained and swallow shame.

sentences.zh: 臣恐自此同類沮失，各起遐心，來者相戒，以為容默，陛下愈孤立無助矣。”

translations.literal: Your servant fears that from this like-minded men will be discouraged and lost, each will turn to distant thoughts, and those who come after will warn one another to be silent and accommodating; Your Majesty will grow ever more isolated and without aid."
translations.idiomatic: Your servant fears that from this like-minded men will be discouraged and lost, each will turn away in heart, and those who come after will warn one another to keep silent and accommodating; Your Majesty will grow ever more isolated and without aid."

sentences.zh: 夏，行都大火，殿中侍御史蔣峴逢君希寵，創為邪說，禁錮言者。

translations.literal: In summer a great fire struck the mobile capital; Palace Attendant Censor Jiang Xian, seeking the ruler's favor, invented perverse theories and shackled those who spoke out.
translations.idiomatic: In summer a great fire struck the mobile capital. Palace Attendant Censor Jiang Xian, seeking the ruler's favor, invented perverse theories and shackled those who spoke out.

sentences.zh: 公許應詔曰：“群臣忠告者眾，而聖意確不可回；

translations.literal: Gongxu responded to the imperial decree, saying: "Many among the ministers have offered loyal counsel, yet the sacred mind is firm and cannot be turned back;"
translations.idiomatic: Gongxu responded to the imperial decree: "Many among the ministers have offered loyal counsel, yet the sacred mind is firm and cannot be turned back;"

sentences.zh: 聖意不可回，而言者不免於激。

translations.literal: When the sacred mind cannot be turned back, those who speak cannot avoid provocation.
translations.idiomatic: When the sacred mind cannot be turned back, those who speak cannot avoid provocation.

sentences.zh: 陛下宜以大舜無藏怒宿怨為心，而參酌於漢文帝之待淮南厲王、我太宗待秦邸之故事，以召和氣，弭眚災，特在一念轉移之頃耳。

translations.literal: Your Majesty should take as your heart the model of Great Shun, who harbored no hidden anger or lingering resentment, and weigh the precedents of Emperor Wen of Han's treatment of the King of Huainan and our Taizong's treatment of the Prince of Qin, to summon harmonious qi and quell calamities—all lies in the turning of a single thought.
translations.idiomatic: Your Majesty should take as your heart the model of Great Shun, who harbored no hidden anger or lingering resentment, and weigh the precedents of Emperor Wen of Han's treatment of the King of Huainan and our Taizong's treatment of the Prince of Qin, to summon harmonious qi and quell calamities—all lies in the turning of a single thought.

sentences.zh: ”遷秘書丞兼考功郎官，竟為峴劾去，差主管雲台觀、和衢州，未上。

translations.literal: He was promoted to Secretary Assistant and Concurrent Review of Merit Bureau official; in the end he was impeached and removed by Jiang Xian, assigned to administer the Yuntai Abbey and concurrently serve at Qu Prefecture; he did not take up the post.
translations.idiomatic: He was promoted to Secretary Assistant and Concurrent Review of Merit Bureau official, but in the end Jiang Xian impeached him and had him removed. He was assigned to administer the Yuntai Abbey and concurrently serve at Qu Prefecture, but did not take up the post.

sentences.zh: 改江東宣撫司參議官，不赴。

translations.literal: He was transferred to serve as consulting officer of the Jiangdong Pacification Commission; he did not go.
translations.idiomatic: He was transferred to serve as consulting officer of the Jiangdong Pacification Commission but did not go.

sentences.zh: 李宗勉入相，以著作佐郎召，兼權尚左郎官兼直舍人院，遷著作郎。

translations.literal: When Li Zongmian entered the chancellorship, Gongxu was summoned as Assistant Drafting Academician, concurrently acting as Left Bureau official of the Ministry of Personnel and direct draftsman of the Academy of Scholarly Worthies; he was promoted to Drafting Academician.
translations.idiomatic: When Li Zongmian entered the chancellorship, Gongxu was summoned as Assistant Drafting Academician, concurrently acting as Left Bureau official of the Ministry of Personnel and direct draftsman of the Academy of Scholarly Worthies, and was promoted to Drafting Academician.

sentences.zh: 時諫官郭磊卿以論事不報出關，徐榮叟亦抗章引去，公許奏：“乞還言官，俾安厥位。

translations.literal: At that time remonstrance official Guo Leiqing left the capital because his memorials on affairs of state went unanswered; Xu Rongsou also submitted a forceful memorial and withdrew; Gongxu memorialized: "I beg that the remonstrance officials be returned to office, so they may rest secure in their posts."
translations.idiomatic: At that time remonstrance official Guo Leiqing left the capital because his memorials on affairs of state went unanswered, and Xu Rongsou also submitted a forceful memorial and withdrew. Gongxu memorialized: "I beg that the remonstrance officials be returned to office so they may rest secure in their posts."

sentences.zh: ”既而史嵩之自江上入相，台諫謝方叔、王萬及磊卿相繼他徙，公許又奏：“外難憑陵，國勢岌若綴旒，朝廷上自為弗靖，陽為遷除，陰奪言職，此中外所以怏怏。”

translations.literal: Soon Shi Songzhi entered the chancellorship from the Yangzi; censors and remonstrators Xie Fangshu, Wang Wan, and Leiqing were transferred away one after another; Gongxu again memorialized: "Foreign perils press upon us, the state's condition hangs by a thread; the court itself is unsettled, outwardly granting transfers while secretly stripping remonstrance posts—this is why inside and outside are discontent."
translations.idiomatic: Soon Shi Songzhi entered the chancellorship from the Yangzi, and censors and remonstrators Xie Fangshu, Wang Wan, and Leiqing were transferred away one after another. Gongxu again memorialized: "Foreign perils press upon us and the state's condition hangs by a thread. The court itself is unsettled, outwardly granting transfers while secretly stripping remonstrance posts—this is why inside and outside are discontent."

sentences.zh: 遷將作少監。

translations.literal: He was promoted to Vice-Director of Imperial Works.
translations.idiomatic: He was promoted to Vice-Director of Imperial Works.

sentences.zh: 大旱，應詔疏時事四條。

translations.literal: During a great drought he responded to the imperial decree with a memorial outlining four current matters.
translations.idiomatic: During a great drought he responded to the imperial decree with a memorial outlining four current matters.

sentences.zh: 又言：“儲極虛位，天下寒心。

translations.literal: He also said: "The heir apparent's position stands empty; the realm is chilled at heart."
translations.idiomatic: He also said: "The heir apparent's position stands empty, and the realm is chilled at heart."

sentences.zh: ”時朝廷令侍從、台諫條具易楮利害，尋降旨以新造十八界折五行使。

translations.literal: At that time the court ordered attendant officials and censor-remonstrators to set forth the pros and cons of changing paper currency; soon an edict was issued making the newly minted Eighteenth Realm notes exchange at five to one.
translations.idiomatic: At that time the court ordered attendant officials and censor-remonstrators to set forth the pros and cons of changing paper currency, and soon an edict was issued making the newly minted Eighteenth Realm notes exchange at five to one.

sentences.zh: 公許繳申省，謂：“廟堂決意更革，本欲重十八界，亦當令十六界、十七界稍有分別，若一時皆以五折一，安保將來十七界與十八界並行而不折閱乎。

translations.literal: Gongxu returned the memorial to the Secretariat, saying: "The court has resolved on reform intending to strengthen the Eighteenth Realm; the Sixteenth and Seventeenth Realms should still be given some distinction; if all at once everything is exchanged at five to one, how can one guarantee that when the Seventeenth and Eighteenth Realms circulate together in future, the Seventeenth will not also be forced down?"
translations.idiomatic: Gongxu returned the memorial to the Secretariat, saying: "The court has resolved on reform intending to strengthen the Eighteenth Realm, and the Sixteenth and Seventeenth Realms should still be given some distinction. If all at once everything is exchanged at five to one, how can one guarantee that when the Seventeenth and Eighteenth Realms circulate together in future, the Seventeenth will not also be forced down?"

sentences.zh: 曷若將十七界且以三兌一，使民間尚知寶此一界，不至一旦貿易不行，令三界各有等第，庶幾公私兩便。

translations.literal: Would it not be better for now to exchange the Seventeenth Realm at three to one, so that the people still know to treasure this realm and trade does not suddenly cease—let the three realms each have their rank, and perhaps both public and private will benefit.
translations.idiomatic: Would it not be better for now to exchange the Seventeenth Realm at three to one, so that the people still know to treasure this realm and trade does not suddenly cease? Let the three realms each have their rank, and perhaps both public and private will benefit.

sentences.zh: ”嵩之格不行，徑揭黃榜。

translations.literal: Songzhi blocked it and would not act; he posted the edict directly on the yellow board.
translations.idiomatic: Songzhi blocked it and would not act; he posted the edict directly on the yellow board.

sentences.zh: 公許謂：“不經鳳閣鸞台，不得為敕。

translations.literal: Gongxu said: "Without passing through the Drafting Office and Secretariat, it cannot count as an imperial edict."
translations.idiomatic: Gongxu said: "Without passing through the Drafting Office and Secretariat, it cannot count as an imperial edict."

sentences.zh: 朝廷出令而宰相擅行如此，則掖垣可廢。

translations.literal: For the court to issue an order yet the chief minister to act on his own authority in this way means the remonstrance offices may as well be abolished.
translations.idiomatic: For the court to issue an order yet the chief minister to act on his own authority in this way means the remonstrance offices may as well be abolished.

sentences.zh: ”累上奏牘，徑欲引去，宗勉及參知政事遊似麵奏留之，兼國史編修、實錄檢討。

translations.literal: He repeatedly submitted memorials and was on the point of resigning; Zongmian and Vice Grand Councilor You Si pleaded face to face to retain him; he was also made compiler of the National History and collator of the Veritable Records.
translations.idiomatic: He repeatedly submitted memorials and was on the point of resigning, but Zongmian and Vice Grand Councilor You Si pleaded face to face to retain him. He was also made compiler of the National History and collator of the Veritable Records.

sentences.zh: 淳祐元年，遷秘書少監，輪對，言蜀事十條。

translations.literal: In the first year of Chunyou he was promoted to Vice-Director of the Secretariat; in turn at audience he spoke on ten matters concerning Shu.
translations.idiomatic: In the first year of Chunyou he was promoted to Vice-Director of the Secretariat and, in turn at audience, spoke on ten matters concerning Shu.

sentences.zh: 兼直學士院，拜太常少卿，力請外，為右正言濮鬥南之所論罷。

translations.literal: He concurrently served as direct draftsman of the Hanlin Academy, was appointed Vice-Minister of Rites, and pressed strongly for an outside post; he was removed because of Right Straight Remonstrator Pu Dounan's criticism.
translations.idiomatic: He concurrently served as direct draftsman of the Hanlin Academy and was appointed Vice-Minister of Rites, but pressed strongly for an outside post and was removed because of Right Straight Remonstrator Pu Dounan's criticism.

sentences.zh: 尋以直寶謨閣知袁州，請蠲和糴之半。

translations.literal: Soon he was made Direct Academician of the Baomo Pavilion and appointed prefect of Yuan Prefecture; he requested remission of half the harmonized grain purchase levy.
translations.idiomatic: Soon he was made Direct Academician of the Baomo Pavilion and appointed prefect of Yuan Prefecture, where he requested remission of half the harmonized grain purchase levy.

sentences.zh: 改命郡吏部總所綱運，而厚其貲，免募平民，民甚便之。

translations.literal: He changed orders so that county clerks would oversee transport of tribute grain in organized groups, increased their pay, and exempted the conscription of commoners; the people found this very convenient.
translations.idiomatic: He changed orders so that county clerks would oversee transport of tribute grain in organized groups, increased their pay, and exempted the conscription of commoners; the people found this very convenient.

sentences.zh: 新周敦頤祠，葺張栻書院，聘宿儒胡安之為諸生講說。

translations.literal: He built a new temple to Zhou Dunyi, repaired Zhang Shi Academy, and engaged the elder scholar Hu Anzhi to lecture the students.
translations.idiomatic: He built a new temple to Zhou Dunyi, repaired Zhang Shi Academy, and engaged the elder scholar Hu Anzhi to lecture the students.

sentences.zh: 杜範薦於上，召拜宗正少卿，再遷起居舍人。

translations.literal: Du Fan recommended him to the throne; he was summoned and appointed Vice-Director of the Court of the Imperial Clan, then promoted again to Attendant in the Office for Writing Current Affairs.
translations.idiomatic: Du Fan recommended him to the throne; he was summoned and appointed Vice-Director of the Court of the Imperial Clan, then promoted again to Attendant in the Office for Writing Current Affairs.

sentences.zh: 濮鬥南繳還，疏有“臣等恥與為伍”之語，遂以舊職提舉玉局觀。

translations.literal: Pu Dounan returned the appointment; his memorial contained the words "We are ashamed to be counted among such company"; Gongxu was thereupon assigned his former post as supervisor of the Yuju Abbey.
translations.idiomatic: Pu Dounan returned the appointment; his memorial contained the words "We are ashamed to be counted among such company," and Gongxu was thereupon assigned his former post as supervisor of the Yuju Abbey.

sentences.zh: 範見疏曰：“程季與肯與汝為伍耶？”

translations.literal: Fan, seeing the memorial, said: "Would Cheng Jiyu consent to be counted among your company?"
translations.idiomatic: When Fan saw the memorial, he said: "Would Cheng Jiyu consent to be counted among your company?"

sentences.zh: 退處二年，召赴行在，屬嵩之以父憂去位，經營起復，益憚公許，密柬韓祥嗾殿中侍御史王讚奏寢召命。

translations.literal: After two years in retirement he was summoned to the mobile capital; as Songzhi was leaving office for his father's mourning and scheming for a return from mourning, he feared Gongxu all the more; he secretly sent a note through Han Xiang urging Palace Attendant Censor Wang Zan to memorialize to hold up the summons.
translations.idiomatic: After two years in retirement he was summoned to the mobile capital. As Songzhi was leaving office for his father's mourning and scheming for a return from mourning, he feared Gongxu all the more and secretly sent a note through Han Xiang urging Palace Attendant Censor Wang Zan to memorialize to hold up the summons.

sentences.zh: 帝雖曲從而意不悅。

translations.literal: The emperor though yielding was displeased at heart.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor yielded, but was displeased at heart.

sentences.zh: 及逐不才台諫，擢公許起居郎兼直學士院。

translations.literal: When incompetent censors and remonstrators were dismissed, Gongxu was promoted to Attendant in the Office for Writing Current Affairs and concurrent direct draftsman of the Hanlin Academy.
translations.idiomatic: When incompetent censors and remonstrators were dismissed, Gongxu was promoted to Attendant in the Office for Writing Current Affairs and concurrent direct draftsman of the Hanlin Academy.

sentences.zh: 公許入奏不可不堅凝者七。

translations.literal: Gongxu entered and memorialized seven matters on which the court must not fail to remain firm.
translations.idiomatic: Gongxu entered and memorialized seven matters on which the court must not fail to remain firm.

sentences.zh: 帝語之曰：“卿一去三年，今用卿，出自朕意。

translations.literal: The emperor told him: "You have been away three years; in employing you now, this comes from my own intent."
translations.idiomatic: The emperor told him: "You have been away three years. In employing you now, this comes from my own intent."

sentences.zh: ”是日晚命下，嵩之罷起復，相範鍾及範，三製皆公許為之。

translations.literal: That evening the order was issued; Songzhi's return from mourning was halted; the appointments of chief minister Fan Zhong and Du Fan—three edicts in all—were all drafted by Gongxu.
translations.idiomatic: That evening the order was issued: Songzhi's return from mourning was halted, and the appointments of chief minister Fan Zhong and Du Fan—three edicts in all—were all drafted by Gongxu.

sentences.zh: 兼權中書舍人。

translations.literal: He concurrently served as acting Drafting Secretary of the Secretariat.
translations.idiomatic: He concurrently served as acting Drafting Secretary of the Secretariat.

sentences.zh: 時二相尚遜，機務多壅。

translations.literal: At that time both chief ministers still practiced deference; urgent business often piled up blocked.
translations.idiomatic: At that time both chief ministers still practiced deference, and urgent business often piled up blocked.

sentences.zh: 公許奏：“輔臣崇執謙遜，避遠形跡，相示以色而不明言，事幾無窮，日月易失。

translations.literal: Gongxu memorialized: "The chief ministers prize humility and deference, keep distant from one another in outward form, signal by looks rather than speak plainly—affairs grow without end and days and months are easily lost."
translations.idiomatic: Gongxu memorialized: "The chief ministers prize humility and deference, keep distant from one another in outward form, and signal by looks rather than speak plainly—affairs grow without end and days and months are easily lost."

sentences.zh: 今最急莫若疆場之事，帥才不蓄，一旦欲議易置，茫然莫知所付。

translations.literal: Nothing is more urgent than frontier affairs; command talent is not being cultivated; once one wishes to discuss replacement, one is blank and knows not whom to appoint.
translations.idiomatic: Nothing is more urgent than frontier affairs. Command talent is not being cultivated, and once one wishes to discuss replacement, one is blank and knows not whom to appoint.

sentences.zh: 九江擇守，至以近所廢斥朋附為欺之台察充其選。

translations.literal: To choose a prefect for Jiujiang, they went so far as to fill the post with a recently dismissed party follower who had deceived the censorate.
translations.idiomatic: To choose a prefect for Jiujiang, they went so far as to fill the post with a recently dismissed party follower who had deceived the censorate.

sentences.zh: 同時任言責者，雖心跡有顯晦，過惡有重輕，而獲罪於清議則同。

translations.literal: Those who at the same time bore the duty of speech, though their motives and conduct differed in clarity, and their faults in severity, alike fell afoul of public opinion.
translations.idiomatic: Those who at the same time bore the duty of speech, though their motives and conduct differed in clarity and their faults in severity, alike fell afoul of public opinion.

sentences.zh: 一人抆拭之驟若是，三人者寧不引領以望玷缺之復。

translations.literal: When one man is wiped clean so abruptly, will not the three stretch their necks hoping for restoration of a blemished record?
translations.idiomatic: When one man is wiped clean so abruptly, will not the three stretch their necks hoping for restoration of a blemished record?

sentences.zh: 況近者言官方以劉晉之、鄭起潛、濮鬥南三人乞明正其罪，以示警戒，而忽聞龔基先之用，議者鹹謂改紀之初，所為錯繆，邪枉窺伺善類，何可高枕而臥。

translations.literal: Moreover, remonstrance officials recently petitioned to clearly establish the crimes of Liu Jinzhi, Zheng Qiqian, and Pu Dounan as a warning; yet suddenly came word of Gong Jixian's appointment—all agreed that at the beginning of a new era such actions were mistaken; the crooked spy on the good—how can one sleep at ease?
translations.idiomatic: Moreover, remonstrance officials recently petitioned to clearly establish the crimes of Liu Jinzhi, Zheng Qiqian, and Pu Dounan as a warning, yet suddenly came word of Gong Jixian's appointment. All agreed that at the beginning of a new era such actions were mistaken; the crooked spy on the good—how can one sleep at ease?

sentences.zh: ”帝見公許疏稱善，且言基先之用太早。

translations.literal: The emperor, reading Gongxu's memorial, praised it and said Gong Jixian's appointment had come too soon.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor, reading Gongxu's memorial, praised it and said Gong Jixian's appointment had come too soon.

sentences.zh: 右史徐元傑暴亡，司諫謝方叔、御史劉應起言，不報。

translations.literal: Right Scribe Xu Yuanjie died suddenly; Remonstrator Xie Fangshu and Censor Liu Yingqi spoke out; no response.
translations.idiomatic: Right Scribe Xu Yuanjie died suddenly. Remonstrator Xie Fangshu and Censor Liu Yingqi spoke out, but received no response.

sentences.zh: 公許亟奏曰：“正月，侍御史劉漢弼死。

translations.literal: Gongxu urgently memorialized: "In the first month, Attendant Censor Liu Hanbi died."
translations.idiomatic: Gongxu urgently memorialized: "In the first month, Attendant Censor Liu Hanbi died."

sentences.zh: 四月，右丞相杜範死。

translations.literal: In the fourth month, Right Chief Minister Du Fan died.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month, Right Chief Minister Du Fan died.

sentences.zh: 六月，右史徐元傑死。

translations.literal: In the sixth month, Right Scribe Xu Yuanjie died.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month, Right Scribe Xu Yuanjie died.

sentences.zh: 漢弼之死固可疑，範之死人言已籍籍，然漢弼類風淫末疾，範亦尫弱多病，諉曰天命，猶可也。

translations.literal: Hanbi's death was indeed suspicious; Fan's death had already stirred much talk; yet Hanbi had symptoms like late-stage wind disorder, and Fan was also frail and often ill—to call it Heaven's mandate could still pass.
translations.idiomatic: Hanbi's death was indeed suspicious, and Fan's death had already stirred much talk; yet Hanbi had symptoms like late-stage wind disorder, and Fan was also frail and often ill—to call it Heaven's mandate could still pass.

sentences.zh: 元傑氣體魁碩，神采嚴毅，議論英發，甫聞謁告，奄至暴亡，口鼻四體變異之狀，使人為之雪涕不已。

translations.literal: Yuanjie was robust in physique, stern and dignified in mien, brilliant in debate—he had only just asked leave when he suddenly died; the altered state of mouth, nose, and limbs makes one weep endlessly.
translations.idiomatic: Yuanjie was robust in physique, stern and dignified in mien, and brilliant in debate. He had only just asked leave when he suddenly died; the altered state of his mouth, nose, and limbs makes one weep endlessly.

sentences.zh: 六館諸生叩閽<簽頁>告，陛下始命有司置獄鞫勘，謂當於朝紳中選公正明決無所顧忌者專蒞其事，盡情研究，務使得實。

translations.literal: Students of the six halls knocked at the palace gates<簽頁> to petition; Your Majesty then ordered the relevant offices to set up a prison for investigation—one should select from the court's worthies someone fair, clear, and fearless to oversee it exclusively, investigate fully, and strive to get at the truth.
translations.idiomatic: Students of the six halls knocked at the palace gates to petition; Your Majesty then ordered the relevant offices to set up a prison for investigation. One should select from the court's worthies someone fair, clear, and fearless to oversee it exclusively, investigate fully, and strive to get at the truth.

sentences.zh: 集議朝堂，分列首從，必誅無赦。

translations.literal: Assemble deliberation in the court hall, distinguish ringleaders from followers, and execute without pardon.
translations.idiomatic: Assemble deliberation in the court hall, distinguish ringleaders from followers, and execute without pardon.

sentences.zh: ”疏入，不報。

translations.literal: The memorial was submitted; no response.
translations.idiomatic: The memorial was submitted, but received no response.

sentences.zh: 物論沸騰，臨安尹趙與芮奏乞置獄天府，帝從之。

translations.literal: Public opinion boiled over; Prefect of Lin'an Zhao Yurui memorialized asking to establish a prison under the Metropolitan Prefecture; the emperor assented.
translations.idiomatic: Public opinion boiled over. Prefect of Lin'an Zhao Yurui memorialized asking to establish a prison under the Metropolitan Prefecture, and the emperor assented.

sentences.zh: 公許繳奏：“與芮乃嵩之死黨，乞改送大理寺，命台臣董之。

translations.literal: Gongxu returned the memorial, saying: "Yurui is Songzhi's sworn partisan; I beg that the case be transferred to the Court of Judicial Review and that censorial officials supervise it."
translations.idiomatic: Gongxu returned the memorial, saying: "Yurui is Songzhi's sworn partisan. I beg that the case be transferred to the Court of Judicial Review and that censorial officials supervise it."

sentences.zh: ”詔殿中侍御史鄭寀，寀回懦首鼠，事竟不白，然公論莫不偉公許。

translations.literal: An edict assigned Palace Attendant Censor Zheng Cai; Cai was timid and indecisive; the matter in the end was never cleared—but public opinion unanimously praised Gongxu.
translations.idiomatic: An edict assigned Palace Attendant Censor Zheng Cai. Cai was timid and indecisive, and the matter in the end was never cleared—but public opinion unanimously praised Gongxu.

sentences.zh: 權禮部侍郎，差充執綏官。

translations.literal: Acting Vice-Minister of Rites; assigned to serve as holder of the reins.
translations.idiomatic: He served as Acting Vice-Minister of Rites and was assigned to hold the reins.

sentences.zh: 鄭起潛、劉晉之及陳一薦以台臣論劾遷謫，公許疏其附下罔上之罪，乞下各州軍嚴行押發。

translations.literal: Zheng Qiqian, Liu Jinzhi, and Chen Yijian had been transferred and demoted after censorial impeachment; Gongxu memorialized their crime of fawning on subordinates and deceiving superiors and begged that each circuit and garrison be ordered to escort them strictly under guard.
translations.idiomatic: Zheng Qiqian, Liu Jinzhi, and Chen Yijian had been transferred and demoted after censorial impeachment. Gongxu memorialized their crime of fawning on subordinates and deceiving superiors and begged that each circuit and garrison be ordered to escort them strictly under guard.

sentences.zh: 鄭清之以少保奉祠，侍講幄中，批復其子士昌官職，與內祠，且許侍養行在所。

translations.literal: Zheng Qingzhi, as Junior Guardian with a sacrificial stipend, while lecturing within the curtain, secured approval of an office for his son Shichang, a position in the inner sacrificial establishment, and permission to attend and serve at the mobile capital.
translations.idiomatic: Zheng Qingzhi, as Junior Guardian with a sacrificial stipend, while lecturing within the curtain, secured approval of an office for his son Shichang, a position in the inner sacrificial establishment, and permission to attend and serve at the mobile capital.

sentences.zh: 蓋士昌嚐以詔獄追逮，或云詐以死聞，清之造闕，泣請於帝，故有是命。

translations.literal: For Shichang had once been pursued and arrested in an imperial prison case; some said he had feigned death; Qingzhi came to the palace gates and tearfully begged the emperor—hence this order.
translations.idiomatic: For Shichang had once been pursued and arrested in an imperial prison case; some said he had feigned death. Qingzhi came to the palace gates and tearfully begged the emperor—hence this order.

sentences.zh: 公許繳奏：“士昌罪重，京都浩穰，奸宄雜糅，恐其積習沉痼，重為清之累；

translations.literal: Gongxu returned the memorial: "Shichang's crime was grave; the capital is crowded, villains mixed in—I fear his deep-seated habits will again burden Qingzhi;"
translations.idiomatic: Gongxu returned the memorial: "Shichang's crime was grave. The capital is crowded and villains mixed in—I fear his deep-seated habits will again burden Qingzhi;"

sentences.zh: 莫若且與甄復，少慰清之，內祠侍養之命宜與收寢。

translations.literal: Better for now to grant him restoration of rank to comfort Qingzhi somewhat; the order for inner-sacrificial attendance should be withdrawn.
translations.idiomatic: Better for now to grant him restoration of rank to comfort Qingzhi somewhat; the order for inner-sacrificial attendance should be withdrawn.

sentences.zh: ”帝密遣中貴人以公許疏示清之。

translations.literal: The emperor secretly sent a eunuch to show Qingzhi Gongxu's memorial.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor secretly sent a eunuch to show Qingzhi Gongxu's memorial.

sentences.zh: 項容孫以罪遣還家，道死，時敘官復職，公許駁奏，命遂格。

translations.literal: Xiang Rongsun was sent home for his crime and died on the road; at the time a memorial was drafted to restore his office; Gongxu rejected it in a memorial and the order was halted.
translations.idiomatic: Xiang Rongsun was sent home for his crime and died on the road. At the time a memorial was drafted to restore his office, but Gongxu rejected it in a memorial and the order was halted.

sentences.zh: 遷中書舍人，進禮部侍郎。

translations.literal: He was promoted to Drafting Secretary of the Secretariat and advanced to Vice-Minister of Rites.
translations.idiomatic: He was promoted to Drafting Secretary of the Secretariat and advanced to Vice-Minister of Rites.

sentences.zh: 嵩之免喪，以觀文殿大學士提舉洞霄宮，台諫、給舍交章論奏，公許疏：“乞睿斷亟下明詔，正邦典。

translations.literal: When Songzhi's mourning ended, he was made Grand Academician of the Hall for Viewing Literature and supervisor of the Dongxiao Abbey; censors, remonstrators, and drafting officials submitted memorial after memorial; Gongxu memorialized: "I beg for sagely judgment to issue a clear edict promptly and uphold the state's norms."
translations.idiomatic: When Songzhi's mourning ended, he was made Grand Academician of the Hall for Viewing Literature and supervisor of the Dongxiao Abbey. Censors, remonstrators, and drafting officials submitted memorial after memorial, and Gongxu memorialized: "I beg for sagely judgment to issue a clear edict promptly and uphold the state's norms."

sentences.zh: ”殿中侍御史章琰、正言李昴英以論執政及府尹，帝怒，出二人，公許力爭之。

translations.literal: Palace Attendant Censor Zhang Yan and Straight Remonstrator Li Angying criticized the chief minister and the prefect; the emperor was angered and dismissed the two; Gongxu argued fiercely on their behalf.
translations.idiomatic: Palace Attendant Censor Zhang Yan and Straight Remonstrator Li Angying criticized the chief minister and the prefect. The emperor was angered and dismissed the two, but Gongxu argued fiercely on their behalf.

sentences.zh: 公許自繳士昌之命，清之日夜於經筵短公許。

translations.literal: Ever since Gongxu had returned Shichang's appointment, Qingzhi day and night spoke ill of Gongxu at the classics lecture.
translations.idiomatic: Ever since Gongxu had returned Shichang's appointment, Qingzhi day and night spoke ill of Gongxu at the classics lecture.

sentences.zh: 周坦妻與清之妻善，因拜坦殿中侍御史。

translations.literal: Zhou Tan's wife was on good terms with Qingzhi's wife; for this Tan was appointed Palace Attendant Censor.
translations.idiomatic: Zhou Tan's wife was on good terms with Qingzhi's wife, and for this Tan was appointed Palace Attendant Censor.

sentences.zh: 坦首疏劾公許，以寶章閣待制知建寧府；

translations.literal: Tan's first memorial impeached Gongxu; he was made Direct Academician of the Baozhang Pavilion and appointed prefect of Jianning Prefecture;
translations.idiomatic: Tan's first memorial impeached Gongxu, and he was made Direct Academician of the Baozhang Pavilion and appointed prefect of Jianning Prefecture;

sentences.zh: 諫議大夫鄭寀又劾之，命遂寢。

translations.literal: Remonstrance Grandee Zheng Cai again impeached him; the order was then held up.
translations.idiomatic: Remonstrance Grandee Zheng Cai again impeached him, and the order was then held up.

sentences.zh: 清之再相，公許屏居湖州者四年，再提舉玉隆觀、差知婺州，未上；

translations.literal: When Qingzhi returned as chief minister, Gongxu lived in seclusion at Huzhou for four years; again made supervisor of the Yulong Abbey and assigned prefect of Wu Prefecture; he did not take up the post;
translations.idiomatic: When Qingzhi returned as chief minister, Gongxu lived in seclusion at Huzhou for four years. He was again made supervisor of the Yulong Abbey and assigned prefect of Wu Prefecture, but did not take up the post;

sentences.zh: 帝欲召為文字官，清之奏已令守婺，帝曰：“朕欲其來。

translations.literal: The emperor wished to summon him as a drafting official; Qingzhi reported that he had already been ordered to hold Wu; the emperor said: "I want him to come."
translations.idiomatic: The emperor wished to summon him as a drafting official. Qingzhi reported that he had already been ordered to hold Wu, but the emperor said: "I want him to come."

sentences.zh: ”乃授權刑部尚書，屢辭弗獲。

translations.literal: He was thereupon granted acting Minister of Punishments; he declined repeatedly but could not be refused.
translations.idiomatic: He was thereupon granted acting Minister of Punishments. He declined repeatedly but could not be refused.

sentences.zh: 入對，上疏貨財，興繕、逐諫臣、開邊釁時弊七事，薦知名士二十九人。

translations.literal: Entering for audience, he submitted a memorial on seven current abuses—squandering wealth, construction projects, driving out remonstrators, provoking border conflict—and recommended twenty-nine renowned scholars.
translations.idiomatic: Entering for audience, he submitted a memorial on seven current abuses—squandering wealth, construction projects, driving out remonstrators, and provoking border conflict—and recommended twenty-nine renowned scholars.

sentences.zh: 時罷京學類申，散遣生徒，公許奏：“京學養士，其法本與三學不侔。

translations.literal: At that time the metropolitan school's category-examination system was abolished and students dispersed; Gongxu memorialized: "The metropolitan school nurtures scholars; its methods were never the same as those of the Three Schools."
translations.idiomatic: At that time the metropolitan school's category-examination system was abolished and students dispersed. Gongxu memorialized: "The metropolitan school nurtures scholars; its methods were never the same as those of the Three Schools."

sentences.zh: 往者立類申之法，重輕得宜，人情便安，近一旦忽以鄉庠教選而更張之，為士亦當自反，未可盡歸咎朝廷也。

translations.literal: In the past the category-examination method was established with due weight—people found it convenient and secure; recently, in a single day, it was overturned for village-school teaching selection; scholars too should reflect on themselves—not every blame can be laid on the court.
translations.idiomatic: In the past the category-examination method was established with due weight, and people found it convenient and secure. Recently, in a single day, it was overturned for village-school teaching selection; scholars too should reflect on themselves—not every blame can be laid on the court.

sentences.zh: 令行之始，臣方還朝，未敢強聒以撓既出之令。

translations.literal: At the beginning of the order's enforcement, your servant had only just returned to court and did not dare clamor loudly to thwart an order already issued.
translations.idiomatic: At the beginning of the order's enforcement, your servant had only just returned to court and did not dare clamor loudly to thwart an order already issued.

sentences.zh: 今士子擾擾道途，經營朝夕，今既未能盡復舊數，莫若權宜以五百為額，仍用類申之法，使遠方遊學者，得以肄習其間。

translations.literal: Now scholars bustle along the roads, scheming day and night; since we cannot yet fully restore the former quota, better provisionally to set five hundred as the limit, still using the category-examination method, so that traveling scholars from afar may study there.
translations.idiomatic: Now scholars bustle along the roads, scheming day and night. Since we cannot yet fully restore the former quota, it would be better provisionally to set five hundred as the limit and still use the category-examination method, so that traveling scholars from afar may study there.

sentences.zh: 京邑四方之極，而庠序一空，弦誦寂寥，遂使逢掖皇皇，市廛昉怨而不敢議，非所以作成士氣、尊崇教化也。

translations.literal: The capital is the apex of the four directions, yet the schools stand empty, recitation silent and desolate, leaving scholars in their sleeves anxious and desperate, the marketplaces beginning to murmur with resentment yet not daring speak—this is no way to build scholar morale and honor instruction.
translations.idiomatic: The capital is the apex of the four directions, yet the schools stand empty and recitation silent and desolate, leaving scholars in their sleeves anxious and desperate while the marketplaces begin to murmur with resentment yet dare not speak out—this is no way to build scholar morale and honor instruction.

sentences.zh: ”清之益不樂。

translations.literal: " Qingzhi grew all the more displeased.
translations.idiomatic: " Qingzhi grew all the more displeased.

sentences.zh: 授稿殿中侍御史陳垓以劾公許，參知政事吳潛奏留之，帝夜半遣小黃門取垓疏入。

translations.literal: [Qingzhi] supplied drafts to Palace Attendant Censor Chen Gai to impeach Gongxu; Vice Grand Councillor Wu Qian memorialized to retain him; at midnight the emperor sent a junior eunuch to fetch Gai's memorial into [the palace].
translations.idiomatic: Qingzhi supplied drafts to Palace Attendant Censor Chen Gai to impeach Gongxu. Vice Grand Councillor Wu Qian memorialized to retain him, and at midnight the emperor sent a junior eunuch to fetch Gai's memorial into the palace.

sentences.zh: 後二日，二府奏公許不宜去，同知樞密院徐清叟上疏論垓。

translations.literal: Two days later, the two chief councils reported that Gongxu should not leave; Associate Grand Councillor of the Military Affairs Commission Xu Qingzou submitted a memorial criticizing Gai.
translations.idiomatic: Two days later, the two chief councils reported that Gongxu should not leave. Associate Grand Councillor of the Military Affairs Commission Xu Qingzou submitted a memorial criticizing Gai.

sentences.zh: 太學生劉黻等百餘人、布衣方和卿伏闕上書論垓。

translations.literal: More than a hundred Imperial University students led by Liu Fu, together with commoner Fang Heqing, prostrated themselves at the palace gate and submitted memorials criticizing Gai.
translations.idiomatic: More than a hundred Imperial University students led by Liu Fu, together with the commoner Fang Heqing, prostrated themselves at the palace gate and submitted memorials criticizing Gai.

sentences.zh: 朝廷尋授寶章閣學士、知隆興府，而公許已死矣。

translations.literal: The court soon appointed him Academician of the Baozhang Pavilion and prefect of Xing Prefecture, but Gongxu was already dead.
translations.idiomatic: The court soon appointed him Academician of the Baozhang Pavilion and prefect of Xing Prefecture, but Gongxu was already dead.

sentences.zh: 遺表上，帝嗟悼，進龍圖閣學士致仕，贈宣奉大夫，官其後，賜賻如令式。

translations.literal: His death memorial was submitted; the emperor sighed in grief, promoted him to Academician of the Longtu Pavilion with retirement, posthumously conferred Xuanfeng Grand Master, granted office to his descendants, and bestowed burial gifts according to regulation.
translations.idiomatic: His death memorial was submitted. The emperor sighed in grief, promoted him to Academician of the Longtu Pavilion with retirement, posthumously conferred Xuanfeng Grand Master upon him, granted office to his descendants, and bestowed burial gifts according to regulation.

sentences.zh: 公許衝澹寡欲，晚年惟一僮侍，食無重味，一裘至十數年不易。

translations.literal: Gongxu was calm and free of desire; in his later years he had only one boy attendant, no rich food, and one fur coat unchanged for a dozen years or more.
translations.idiomatic: Gongxu was calm and free of desire. In his later years he had only one boy attendant, ate no rich food, and kept one fur coat unchanged for a dozen years or more.

sentences.zh: 家無羨儲，敬愛親戚備至。

translations.literal: His household had no surplus stores; he treated kinsmen with utmost respect and affection.
translations.idiomatic: His household had no surplus stores, and he treated kinsmen with utmost respect and affection.

sentences.zh: 蜀有兵難，族姻奔東南者多依公許以居。

translations.literal: When Sichuan suffered military turmoil, many clansmen fleeing southeast depended on Gongxu for shelter.
translations.idiomatic: When Sichuan suffered military turmoil, many clansmen fleeing southeast depended on Gongxu for shelter.

sentences.zh: 所著有《塵缶文集》、內外製、奏議、《奏常擬諡》、《掖垣繳奏》、《金革講義》、《進故事》行世。

translations.literal: His writings in circulation include the Chen Fu Collection, inner and outer edicts, memorials, Drafting Regular Posthumous Titles, Returned Memorials from the Secretariat, Lectures on Military Affairs, and Submitted Historical Precedents.
translations.idiomatic: His writings in circulation include the Chen Fu Collection, inner and outer edicts, memorials, Drafting Regular Posthumous Titles, Returned Memorials from the Secretariat, Lectures on Military Affairs, and Submitted Historical Precedents.

sentences.zh: 羅必元，字亨父，隆興進賢人。

translations.literal: Luo Biyuan, styled Hengfu, was a native of Jinxian in Longxing.
translations.idiomatic: Luo Biyuan, styled Hengfu, was a native of Jinxian in Longxing.

sentences.zh: 嘉定十年進士。

translations.literal: He passed the jinshi examination in the tenth year of Jiading.
translations.idiomatic: He passed the jinshi examination in the tenth year of Jiading.

sentences.zh: 調鹹寧尉，撫州司法參軍，崇仁丞，復攝司法。

translations.literal: He was appointed assistant magistrate of Xianning, judicial aide in Fuzhou Prefecture, assistant magistrate of Chongren, and again acting judicial aide.
translations.idiomatic: He was appointed assistant magistrate of Xianning, judicial aide in Fuzhou Prefecture, assistant magistrate of Chongren, and again acting judicial aide.

sentences.zh: 郡士曾極題金陵行宮龍屏，迕丞相史彌遠，謫道州，解吏窘極甚。

translations.literal: A local scholar Zeng Ji inscribed the dragon screen of the Jinling traveling palace, offending Chief Minister Shi Miyuan; he was demoted to Da Prefecture, and the escorting clerk treated him with extreme harshness.
translations.idiomatic: A local scholar, Zeng Ji, inscribed the dragon screen of the Jinling traveling palace and offended Chief Minister Shi Miyuan. He was demoted to Da Prefecture, and the escorting clerk treated him with extreme harshness.

sentences.zh: 必元釋其縛，使之善達。

translations.literal: Biyuan released his bonds and had him conveyed properly.
translations.idiomatic: Biyuan released his bonds and had him conveyed properly.

sentences.zh: 真德秀入參大政，必元移書曰：“老醫嚐雲，傷寒壞證，惟獨參湯可救之，然其活者十無二三。

translations.literal: When Zhen Dexiu entered to participate in great affairs of state, Biyuan sent him a letter saying: "An old physician once said that in the terminal stage of cold-damage illness, only ginseng decoction can save the patient—yet of those saved, scarcely two or three in ten survive."
translations.idiomatic: When Zhen Dexiu entered to participate in great affairs of state, Biyuan sent him a letter saying: "An old physician once said that in the terminal stage of cold-damage illness, only ginseng decoction can save the patient—yet of those saved, scarcely two or three in ten survive."

sentences.zh: 先生其今之獨參湯乎？

translations.literal: Are you not today's ginseng-only decoction?
translations.idiomatic: Are you not today's ginseng-only decoction?

sentences.zh: ”調福州觀察推官。

translations.literal: " He was transferred to serve as push officer of the Fuzhou Observation Commission.
translations.idiomatic: " He was transferred to serve as push officer of the Fuzhou Observation Commission.

sentences.zh: 有勢家李遇奪民荔支園，必元直之；

translations.literal: A powerful family, the Lis, led by Yu, seized a commoner's lychee orchard; Biyuan upheld justice for the victim;
translations.idiomatic: A powerful family, the Lis, led by Yu, seized a commoner's lychee orchard, and Biyuan upheld justice for the victim;

sentences.zh: 遇為言官，以私憾罷之”知餘幹縣。

translations.literal: Yu became a remonstrating official and dismissed him out of personal grudge; he was appointed magistrate of Yugan County.
translations.idiomatic: Yu became a remonstrating official and dismissed him out of personal grudge; he was then appointed magistrate of Yugan County.

sentences.zh: 趙福王府驕橫，前後宰貳多為擠陷，至是以汝愚墓占四周民山，亦為直之，言於州曰：“區區小官，罷去何害？

translations.literal: Prince Zhao Fu's household was arrogant and overbearing; successive prefects and vice-prefects had often been squeezed out and framed; now they seized the surrounding commoners' hills around Zhao Ruyu's tomb, and Biyuan again upheld justice, saying to the prefect: "A petty official like me—what harm if dismissed?"
translations.idiomatic: Prince Zhao Fu's household was arrogant and overbearing; successive prefects and vice-prefects had often been squeezed out and framed. Now they seized the surrounding commoners' hills around Zhao Ruyu's tomb, and Biyuan again upheld justice, saying to the prefect: "A petty official like me—what harm if dismissed?"

sentences.zh: ”人益壯其風力。

translations.literal: " People admired his moral force all the more.
translations.idiomatic: " People admired his moral force all the more.

sentences.zh: 淳祐中，通判贛州。

translations.literal: In the Chunyou era he served as vice-prefect of Gan Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: In the Chunyou era he served as vice-prefect of Gan Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 賈似道總領京湖，克剝至甚。

translations.literal: Jia Sidao had overall charge of Jinghu and extorted to an extreme degree.
translations.idiomatic: Jia Sidao had overall charge of Jinghu and extorted the people to an extreme degree.

sentences.zh: 必元上疏，以為蠹國脈、傷民命，似道銜之。

translations.literal: Biyuan submitted a memorial, arguing that this gnawed at the nation's lifeblood and harmed the people's livelihood; Sidao bore a grudge against him.
translations.idiomatic: Biyuan submitted a memorial, arguing that this gnawed at the nation's lifeblood and harmed the people's livelihood. Sidao bore a grudge against him.

sentences.zh: 改知汀州，為御史丁大全按去，後起幹行在糧料院。

translations.literal: He was transferred to serve as prefect of Ting Prefecture, was removed by Censor Ding Daquan, and later reappointed director of the mobile capital grain office.
translations.idiomatic: He was transferred to serve as prefect of Ting Prefecture but was removed by Censor Ding Daquan. He was later reappointed director of the mobile capital grain office.

sentences.zh: 錢塘有海鰍為患，漂民居，詔方士治之，都人鼓扇成風。

translations.literal: In Qiantang sea lampreys became a plague, sweeping away people's homes; an edict ordered Daoist masters to treat the affliction, and the capital's people stirred up a fad.
translations.idiomatic: In Qiantang sea lampreys became a plague and swept away people's homes. An edict ordered Daoist masters to treat the affliction, and the capital's people stirred up a fad.
