sentences.zh: 必元上疏力止之。

translations.literal: Biyuan submitted a memorial forcefully urging that it be stopped.
translations.idiomatic: Biyuan submitted a memorial forcefully urging that it be stopped.

sentences.zh: 帝召見曰：“見卿《梅花詩》，足知卿誌。

translations.literal: The emperor summoned him for audience and said: "Having read your 'Plum Blossom Poem,' I know your resolve well enough."
translations.idiomatic: The emperor summoned him for audience and said: "Having read your 'Plum Blossom Poem,' I know your resolve well enough."

sentences.zh: ”度宗即位，以直寶章閣兼宗學博士致仕。

translations.literal: " When Emperor Duzong acceded, he was made Direct Academician of the Baozhang Pavilion and concurrently Imperial Clan School professor, with retirement.
translations.idiomatic: " When Emperor Duzong acceded, he was made Direct Academician of the Baozhang Pavilion and concurrently Imperial Clan School professor, with retirement.

sentences.zh: 卒，年九十一。

translations.literal: He died at the age of ninety-one.
translations.idiomatic: He died at the age of ninety-one.

sentences.zh: 必元嚐從危稹、包遜學，最為有淵源，見理甚明，風節甚高，至今鄉人猶尊慕之雲。

translations.literal: Biyuan had studied under Wei Zhen and Bao Xun; he was deepest in learning, saw principle with great clarity, and bore moral integrity of the highest order—villagers still honor and admire him to this day.
translations.idiomatic: Biyuan had studied under Wei Zhen and Bao Xun. He was deepest in learning, saw principle with great clarity, and bore moral integrity of the highest order—villagers still honor and admire him to this day.

sentences.zh: 王遂字去非，一字穎叔，樞密副使韶之玄孫，後為鎮江府金壇人。

translations.literal: Wang Sui, styled Qufei and also Yingshu, was the great-great-grandson of Vice Commissioner of Military Affairs Shao; his family later became natives of Jintan in Runzhou Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: Wang Sui, styled Qufei and also Yingshu, was the great-great-grandson of Vice Commissioner of Military Affairs Shao; his family later became natives of Jintan in Runzhou Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 嘉泰二年進士，調富陽主簿，曆官差幹辦諸司審計司。

translations.literal: He passed the jinshi examination in the second year of Jiatai, was appointed chief clerk of Fuyang, and served as assigned clerk of the Bureau for Auditing Various Offices.
translations.idiomatic: He passed the jinshi examination in the second year of Jiatai, was appointed chief clerk of Fuyang, and served as assigned clerk of the Bureau for Auditing Various Offices.

sentences.zh: 紹定三年，福建寇擾甫定，朝廷選賢能吏，勞來安集，以遂知邵武軍兼福建招捕司參議官。

translations.literal: In the third year of Shaoding, bandit disturbances in Fujian had just been settled; the court selected able officials to comfort and resettle the people, appointing Sui prefect of Shaowu Army and concurrently deliberation officer of the Fujian Pacification Commission.
translations.idiomatic: In the third year of Shaoding, bandit disturbances in Fujian had just been settled. The court selected able officials to comfort and resettle the people, appointing Sui prefect of Shaowu Army and concurrently deliberation officer of the Fujian Pacification Commission.

sentences.zh: 遂過江山、浦城道中，遇邵武避地之人，即遺金為歸資，從者如市。

translations.literal: On the road through Jiangshan and Pucheng, Sui met people from Shaowu fleeing to safer ground and immediately gave them gold for travel expenses; those who followed him were like a market crowd.
translations.idiomatic: On the road through Jiangshan and Pucheng, Sui met people from Shaowu fleeing to safer ground and immediately gave them gold for travel expenses. Those who followed him were like a market crowd.

sentences.zh: 至郡，撫摩創痍，翦平凶孽，民恃以安。

translations.literal: Upon reaching the prefecture, he soothed the wounds of war, cut down violent criminals, and the people relied on him for security.
translations.idiomatic: Upon reaching the prefecture, he soothed the wounds of war and cut down violent criminals, and the people relied on him for security.

sentences.zh: 未幾，言者以遂妄自標致，邀譽沽名，罷。

translations.literal: Before long, critics charged that Sui presumptuously promoted himself and sought praise to buy a reputation; he was dismissed.
translations.idiomatic: Before long, critics charged that Sui presumptuously promoted himself and sought praise to buy a reputation, and he was dismissed.

sentences.zh: 改知安豐軍，遷國子監主簿，又遷太常寺主簿，拜監察御史。

translations.literal: He was transferred to serve as prefect of Anfeng Army, promoted to registrar of the Directorate of Education, then promoted to registrar of the Court of Imperial Sacrifices, and appointed investigating censor.
translations.idiomatic: He was transferred to serve as prefect of Anfeng Army, promoted to registrar of the Directorate of Education, then promoted to registrar of the Court of Imperial Sacrifices, and appointed investigating censor.

sentences.zh: 疏奏極論進君子，退小人。

translations.literal: In memorials he argued at length for advancing gentlemen and removing petty men.
translations.idiomatic: In memorials he argued at length for advancing gentlemen and removing petty men.

sentences.zh: 又言正風俗，息奔競。

translations.literal: He also urged rectifying custom and ending frantic competition for office.
translations.idiomatic: He also urged rectifying custom and ending frantic competition for office.

sentences.zh: 又言：“朝廷謂史嵩之小黠為大智，近功為遠略。

translations.literal: He also said: "The court treats Shi Songzhi's petty cleverness as great wisdom and near-term gains as far-reaching strategy."
translations.idiomatic: He also said: "The court treats Shi Songzhi's petty cleverness as great wisdom and near-term gains as far-reaching strategy."

sentences.zh: 忽臣之言，必欲僥幸嵩之於不敗，非為國至計也。

translations.literal: Disregarding your servant's words, you insist on hoping Songzhi may yet not fail—this is no supreme plan for the state.
translations.idiomatic: Disregarding your servant's words, you insist on hoping Songzhi may yet not fail—this is no supreme plan for the state.

sentences.zh: 欺君誤國，天下知之，而朝廷猶且惑焉，勢甚凜凜也。

translations.literal: Deceiving the ruler and misleading the state—everyone under Heaven knows it, yet the court is still bewildered; the situation is deeply alarming.
translations.idiomatic: Deceiving the ruler and misleading the state—everyone under Heaven knows it, yet the court is still bewildered. The situation is deeply alarming.

sentences.zh: ”入對，言帝知、仁、勇，學有未至。

translations.literal: " Entering for audience, he spoke of the emperor's knowledge, benevolence, and courage, saying his learning had not yet reached completion.
translations.idiomatic: " Entering for audience, he spoke of the emperor's knowledge, benevolence, and courage, saying his learning had not yet reached completion.

sentences.zh: 遷右正言，尋拜殿中侍御史。

translations.literal: He was promoted to Right Straight Remonstrator and soon appointed Palace Attendant Censor.
translations.idiomatic: He was promoted to Right Straight Remonstrator and soon appointed Palace Attendant Censor.

sentences.zh: 疏言：“三十年來凶德參會，未有如李知孝、梁成大、莫澤肆無忌憚者。

translations.literal: In a memorial he said: "In thirty years no convergence of vicious conduct has matched the unrestrained audacity of Li Zhixiao, Liang Chengdang, and Mo Ze."
translations.idiomatic: In a memorial he said: "In thirty years no convergence of vicious conduct has matched the unrestrained audacity of Li Zhixiao, Liang Chengdang, and Mo Ze."

sentences.zh: 三凶之罪，上通於天，乞重其刑。

translations.literal: The crimes of these three villains reach up to Heaven; I beg that their punishments be made heavier.
translations.idiomatic: The crimes of these three villains reach up to Heaven; I beg that their punishments be made heavier.

sentences.zh: ” 又取劉光祖為殿中侍御史時奏格，擇其關於風化切於時宜者，請頒示中外。

translations.literal: " He also took the memorial forms Liu Guangzu had used when serving as Palace Attendant Censor, selected those bearing on custom and urgent for the times, and asked that they be promulgated within and without the court.
translations.idiomatic: " He also took the memorial forms Liu Guangzu had used when serving as Palace Attendant Censor, selected those bearing on custom and urgent for the times, and asked that they be promulgated within and without the court.

sentences.zh: 皆從之。

translations.literal: All were approved.
translations.idiomatic: All were approved.

sentences.zh: 又請於並淮置屯田，且條上邊事曰：“當今之急務：在朝廷者五，定規摹，明意向，一心力，謹事權，審號令；

translations.literal: He also asked to establish garrison farms along the Huai and submitted a detailed account of frontier affairs: "Today's urgent tasks: within the court, five—settle the plan, clarify intent, unify effort, handle authority with care, and examine orders;"
translations.idiomatic: He also asked to establish garrison farms along the Huai and submitted a detailed account of frontier affairs: "Today's urgent tasks: within the court, five—settle the plan, clarify intent, unify effort, handle authority with care, and examine orders;"

sentences.zh: 在邊閫者六，恤歸附，精間諜，節財用，練士兵，擇將才，計軍實。

translations.literal: on the frontier, six—show concern for those who submit, refine espionage, economize expenditures, drill local troops, select commanders of talent, and reckon military stores.
translations.idiomatic: On the frontier, six—show concern for those who submit, refine espionage, economize expenditures, drill local troops, select commanders of talent, and reckon military stores.

sentences.zh: ”又言：“君德必純乎剛。

translations.literal: " He also said: "The ruler's virtue must be purely firm."
translations.idiomatic: " He also said: "The ruler's virtue must be purely firm."

sentences.zh: ”帝皆善之。

translations.literal: " The emperor approved all of it.
translations.idiomatic: " The emperor approved all of it.

sentences.zh: 遷戶部侍郎兼同修國史實錄院同修撰，時暫兼權侍左侍郎。

translations.literal: He was promoted to Vice-Minister of Revenue and concurrently associate compiler of the Veritable Records in the National History Office, and for a time also acting Left Vice-Minister of the Secretariat.
translations.idiomatic: He was promoted to Vice-Minister of Revenue and concurrently associate compiler of the Veritable Records in the National History Office, and for a time also acting Left Vice-Minister of the Secretariat.

sentences.zh: 以寶章閣待制差知遂寧府。

translations.literal: As Direct Academician of the Baozhang Pavilion he was assigned prefect of Suining Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: As Direct Academician of the Baozhang Pavilion he was assigned prefect of Suining Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 進煥章閣待制、四川安撫製置副使兼知成都府。

translations.literal: He was advanced to Direct Academician of the Huanzhang Pavilion, Vice Commissioner of the Sichuan Pacification and Military Commission, and concurrently prefect of Chengdu Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: He was advanced to Direct Academician of the Huanzhang Pavilion, Vice Commissioner of the Sichuan Pacification and Military Commission, and concurrently prefect of Chengdu Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 差知平江府。

translations.literal: He was assigned prefect of Pingjiang Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: He was assigned prefect of Pingjiang Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 進敷文閣待制、知慶元府，改知太平州，以論罷。

translations.literal: He was advanced to Direct Academician of the Fuwen Pavilion and appointed prefect of Qingyuan Prefecture, then transferred to Taiping Prefecture, and was dismissed after criticism.
translations.idiomatic: He was advanced to Direct Academician of the Fuwen Pavilion and appointed prefect of Qingyuan Prefecture, then transferred to Taiping Prefecture, and was dismissed after criticism.

sentences.zh: 進顯謨閣待制、知泉州。

translations.literal: He was advanced to Direct Academician of the Xianmo Pavilion and appointed prefect of Quan Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: He was advanced to Direct Academician of the Xianmo Pavilion and appointed prefect of Quan Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 改溫州、寧國府。

translations.literal: He was transferred to Wen Prefecture and Ningguo Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: He was transferred to Wen Prefecture and Ningguo Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 以寶章閣直學士知建寧府。

translations.literal: As Academician of the Baozhang Pavilion he was appointed prefect of Jianning Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: As Academician of the Baozhang Pavilion he was appointed prefect of Jianning Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 以華文閣直學士差知隆興府兼江西轉運副使。

translations.literal: As Academician of the Huawen Pavilion he was assigned prefect of Xing Prefecture and concurrently Vice Transport Commissioner of Jiangxi.
translations.idiomatic: As Academician of the Huawen Pavilion he was assigned prefect of Xing Prefecture and concurrently Vice Transport Commissioner of Jiangxi.

sentences.zh: 改知太平州，復知隆興兼江西安撫使。

translations.literal: He was transferred to Taiping Prefecture, then again appointed prefect of Xing Prefecture and concurrently Jiangxi Pacification Commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: He was transferred to Taiping Prefecture, then again appointed prefect of Xing Prefecture and concurrently Jiangxi Pacification Commissioner.

sentences.zh: 召赴闕，授權工部尚書。

translations.literal: He was summoned to court and granted acting Minister of Works.
translations.idiomatic: He was summoned to court and granted acting Minister of Works.

sentences.zh: 遂與同裏劉宰素同誌，宰嚐稱遂為文雅健，無世俗浮靡之氣，足以名世。

translations.literal: Sui and his fellow townsman Liu Zai had long shared the same ideals; Zai once praised Sui as refined yet robust in prose, free of worldly ostentation, and worthy of making a name in his age.
translations.idiomatic: Sui and his fellow townsman Liu Zai had long shared the same ideals. Zai once praised Sui as refined yet robust in prose, free of worldly ostentation, and worthy of making a name in his age.

sentences.zh: 遂守平江，宰贈之言曰：“士友當親，而賢否不可不辨；

translations.literal: When Sui was prefect of Pingjiang, Zai sent him parting words: "Scholarly friends should be kept close, yet the worthy and unworthy must be distinguished;"
translations.idiomatic: When Sui was prefect of Pingjiang, Zai sent him parting words: "Scholarly friends should be kept close, yet the worthy and unworthy must be distinguished;"

sentences.zh: 財利當遠，而會計不可不明。

translations.literal: wealth and profit should be kept at a distance, yet accounts must not be unclear.
translations.idiomatic: Wealth and profit should be kept at a distance, yet accounts must not be unclear.

sentences.zh: 折獄以情，毋為私意所牽；

translations.literal: decide cases according to the facts, and do not be swayed by private feeling;
translations.idiomatic: Decide cases according to the facts, and do not be swayed by private feeling;

sentences.zh: 薦士以才，毋為權要所奪。

translations.literal: recommend scholars for their talent, and do not let powerful figures take them away.
translations.idiomatic: Recommend scholars for their talent, and do not let powerful figures take them away.

sentences.zh: 當言則言，不視時而退縮；

translations.literal: When one should speak, speak—do not shrink back according to the times;
translations.idiomatic: When one should speak, speak—do not shrink back according to the times;

sentences.zh: 可去則去，不計利而遲回。

translations.literal: when one may leave, leave—do not hesitate out of calculation for profit.
translations.idiomatic: When one may leave, leave—do not hesitate out of calculation for profit.

sentences.zh: 庶幾名節之全，不愧簡冊所載。

translations.literal: Then perhaps one's name and integrity may remain whole, without shame before what the annals record.
translations.idiomatic: Then perhaps one's name and integrity may remain whole, without shame before what the annals record.

sentences.zh: ”蓋格言也。

translations.literal: " These were maxims indeed.
translations.idiomatic: " These were maxims indeed.

sentences.zh: 論曰：“傅伯成晚與楊簡為時蓍龜。

translations.literal: The historians comment: "Fu Bocheng, in his later years together with Yang Jian, served as the age's divining tortoise and yarrow."
translations.idiomatic: The historians comment: "Fu Bocheng, in his later years together with Yang Jian, served as the age's divining tortoise and yarrow."

sentences.zh: 葛洪守正不阿。

translations.literal: Ge Hong upheld the upright and would not bend.
translations.idiomatic: Ge Hong upheld the upright and would not bend.

sentences.zh: 曾三復澹然無躁競之心。

translations.literal: Ceng Sanfu was serene and free of a restless, competitive heart.
translations.idiomatic: Ceng Sanfu was serene and free of a restless, competitive heart.

sentences.zh: 黃疇若優於政治。

translations.literal: Huang Chouruo excelled in governance.
translations.idiomatic: Huang Chouruo excelled in governance.

sentences.zh: 袁韶力請討李全，蓋丞相史彌遠腹心也。

translations.literal: Yuan Shao strongly urged the campaign against Li Quan—he was, in effect, Chief Minister Shi Miyuan's trusted confidant.
translations.idiomatic: Yuan Shao strongly urged the campaign against Li Quan—he was, in effect, Chief Minister Shi Miyuan's trusted confidant.

sentences.zh: 危稹以通問徐僑獲罪，其人可知，矧治州之政，有循吏之風焉。

translations.literal: Wei Zhen was punished for communicating with Xu Qiao—from this his character may be known; moreover, in governing his prefecture he bore the manner of an exemplary official.
translations.idiomatic: Wei Zhen was punished for communicating with Xu Qiao—from this his character may be known. Moreover, in governing his prefecture he bore the manner of an exemplary official.

sentences.zh: 羅必元受學於稹者也。

translations.literal: Luo Biyuan was one who received learning from Zhen.
translations.idiomatic: Luo Biyuan was one who received learning from Zhen.

sentences.zh: 程公許、王遂讜論疊見，豈不偉哉。

translations.literal: Cheng Gongxu and Wang Sui put forth frank counsel again and again—how grand indeed.
translations.idiomatic: Cheng Gongxu and Wang Sui put forth frank counsel again and again—how grand indeed.
